title: Calibrate an RSYC Yield Curve with Local Observations — calibrate_rsyc
text: RSYC models nonlinear mixed-effects models tile- pixel-level random effects act \(\beta_1\), parameter associated maximum biomass (volume) potential (asymptote parameter): $$AGB_{ijk} = (\beta_1 + b_i + b_{ij})\,g(age_{ijk}) + \epsilon_{ijk}$$ \(\) indexes tile, \(j\) pixel nested within tile, \(k\) age, \(g(age) = e^{-\beta_4 age}(1 - e^{-\beta_2 age})^{\beta_3}\) age-related modifier. random effects residual errors assumed independent normally distributed mean zero. Hats denote estimated values. b1 coefficient published RSYC_models tile-level asymptote parameter, already equal \(\hat\beta_1 + \hat b_i\), yield curve based tile-level conditional prediction \(\texttt{b1} \cdot \hat g(age)\). Local calibration estimates pixel-level random effect \(b_{ij}\) calibration plot (assumed coincide pixel \(j\) within tile \(\)) conditional fitted model. Given observations \(y_{ijk}\) ages \(age_{ijk}\), \(m_{ijk} = \hat g(age_{ijk})\), $$\hat b_{ij} = \frac{\sum_k m_{ijk} (y_{ijk} - \texttt{b1} \cdot   m_{ijk})}{\sum_k m_{ijk}^2 + \hat\sigma^2_\epsilon / \hat\sigma^2_b}$$ \(\hat\sigma^2_b\) estimated pixel-level (nested within tile) random-effect variance \(\hat\sigma^2_\epsilon\) estimated residual variance. \(\hat\sigma^2_\epsilon / \hat\sigma^2_b\) term shrinks weak local evidence toward adjustment. calibrated curve substitutes adjusted asymptote parameter equation, $$(\texttt{b1} + \hat b_{ij})\,\hat g(age)$$ equivalent scaling published curve \((\texttt{b1} + \hat b_{ij}) / \texttt{b1}\), reported ratio_blup. single observation becomes one-point level anchor. result read single-observation BLUP-anchored RSYC curve, local growth trajectory learned data.
